pnpmWorkspace:
packages:
  - .

nodeLinker: hoisted
autoInstallPeers: false

# pnpm will not run a git-hosted package's build/prepare script until its exact
# dependency path is allowed. The commit is part of the key, so installing a
# different commit of dsh-config-manager requires updating this entry.
allowBuilds:
  "dsh-config-manager@https://codeload.github.com/xiajiajun516/dsh-config-manager/tar.gz/3b999a21dac391bf29fad996d40d8d7a4e3dbc07": true

minimumReleaseAgeExclude:
  - dsh-config-manager@0.3.0
